mainEntity.name: What does a typical kitchen plumbing installation project involve?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical kitchen plumbing installation involves connecting new fixtures like sinks, faucets, dishwashers, and garbage disposals to the existing water supply and drain lines. This can also include installing new pipes or rerouting existing ones to accommodate a new layout. Frasheski Construction ensures all installations comply with local Berkeley and East Bay building codes, providing peace of mind that your plumbing is safe and up to standard. The process usually begins with disconnecting old fixtures, followed by preparing the space for new ones, and finally connecting and testing the new plumbing components.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen plumbing installation typically involves connecting new fixtures and appliances to water supply and drain lines, potentially rerouting pipes, and ensuring compliance with local building codes.
